paras.en: When the ball completely crosses the touch line a throw-in is given. The team of the player from whom the ball last touched and went will have the throw-in given to its opposing team from that same spot. Both feet of the thrower will be in contact with the ground. He will throw in the ball with the force of both hands. A goal cannot be scored directly from a throw-in. The thrower cannot play the thrown-in ball himself until it touches another player. If the thrower commits a foul the throw-in will be given to the opponent from the same place, and if a player of the defending team commits a foul the throw-in will be given again. Crossing the touch line or the contact of the foot with the ground ending is a foul.
